LESSON: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.2: The Human Breathing System

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Human Breathing System. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes up the human breathing system?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Human Breathing System helps you succeed in SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM
Study The Human Breathing System like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the main parts of the human breathing system

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the main parts of the human breathing system. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the main parts of the human breathing system.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “The Human Breathing System” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the main parts of the human breathing system. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why The Human Breathing System matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Human Breathing System is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “The Human Breathing System” around your school. (skill: identify the main parts of the human breathing system)

Example 2: Say why The Human Breathing System matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Human Breathing System to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the main parts of the human breathing system.
3. Practise this skill: describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system.
4. Make one local Kenya example of The Human Breathing System from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Human Breathing System: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study The Human Breathing System?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes up the human breathing system?
2. What enhances a healthy breathing system?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Human Breathing System means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the main parts of the human breathing system.
5. Be able to: describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
